# The files scripts/regenerate-content.sh produces from local inputs, in .gitignore syntax relative
# to the repository root. None is tracked: .gitignore carries a copy of these lines, the script
# removes them before it runs and refuses a run that leaves an unignored generated file, and the test
# suites skip what reads them when they are absent. The authored base payload
# content/worldrpg/payloads/daggerfall.base.json is tracked; the imported payload beside it holds
# every derived base section.
/content/worldrpg/imports/
/content/worldrpg/media/
/content/worldrpg/payloads/daggerfall.imported.json
/content/worldrpg/payloads/daggerfall.blocks.json
/content/worldrpg/payloads/daggerfall.quests.*.json
/import-records/
